discovery: The theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators (quantum spin Hall effect)
rationale: Recent prizes went to attosecond physics, quantum entanglement, machine learning and superconducting quantum circuits, so experimental condensed matter looks due for a turn. Topological insulators are a field-defining condensed-matter discovery with major awards behind them (Breakthrough, Dirac, Buckley). They pair a clean theory prediction (Kane-Mele Z2 invariant) with a decisive experiment (Molenkamp's HgTe quantum wells). Shoucheng Zhang's death in 2018 leaves a natural trio.
